issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Clara AI SDR
products.tagline: Turn website visitors into qualified pipeline
products.summaryZh: 将网站访客转化为合格的销售线索。
products.descriptionZh: Clara是一款AI销售开发代表，能将网站访客转化为销售线索，实时进行互动、资格筛选、产品演示、处理异议并预约会议。无需填写表格，无需等待，无需额外人力。全天候销售，无缝集成CRM。
products.description: Clara is an AI SDR that converts inbound website traffic into pipeline - engaging, qualifying, demoing, handling objections, and booking meetings in real time. No forms. No waiting. No extra headcount. 24/7 selling with seamless CRM integration.

products.name: Taku AI
products.tagline: Borrow the best AI setups and make them yours.
products.summaryZh: 借鉴最佳AI配置，化为己用。
products.descriptionZh: AI正变得异常强大——但使用起来却愈发复杂。Taku解决了这最后一公里。它将最优秀的技能、智能体和流程转化为真正的桌面应用，任何人都能运行、改造并打造属于自己的版本。借鉴专家的配置，跳过GitHub和繁琐的设置，或者直接告诉Taku你的需求，它会为你组装好整套方案。你使用得越多，Taku就越了解你的需求——并为你带来合适的工具。
products.description: AI is getting insanely powerful — and somehow harder to use. Taku fixes the last mile. It turns the best skills, agents, and workflows into real desktop apps anyone can run, remix, and make their own. Borrow setups from the pros, skip GitHub and setup, or just tell Taku what you want and watch it assemble the stack. The more you work, the more Taku learns what you need — and brings the right tools to you.

products.name: Superflow AI
products.tagline: AI agents that QA your website before launch
products.summaryZh: 上线前对网站进行QA的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: Superflow将你已有的QA检查清单转化为一组AI代理。它们会扫描每个页面，覆盖桌面端和移动端，并将所有发现直接标记在实时网站上。代理处理黑白分明的问题，审美判断仍由你掌控。代理会学习：被拒绝的发现不再重复出现，遗漏项会成为未来网站的检查点。团队反馈称，他们能捕捉到约90%此前手动发现的问题。兼容Webflow、Framer、WordPress、Shopify、Next.js、Netlify等平台。
products.description: Superflow turns the QA checklist you already use into a team of AI agents. They sweep every page, desktop and mobile, and pin every finding on the live site. Agents handle the black and white issues. Taste stays with you. Agents learn: rejected findings stop coming back, and misses become checks on future sites. Teams say they catch ~90% of what they found by hand. Works with Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, Netlify + more.

products.name: Hubble
products.tagline: Retrieve medical records other APIs can't
products.summaryZh: 获取其他API无法获取的医疗记录
products.descriptionZh: 病历仍困在传真线路、电话菜单和无人记得的登录门户之后。患者只需验证一次身份，Hubble便会从各医疗服务提供方汇集其病历，并通过一个API返回，供你的AI代理使用。
products.description: Medical records still live behind fax lines, phone trees, and portal logins nobody remembers. A patient verifies their identity once, and Hubble assembles their records from across their providers and returns them through one API, for your AI agent to use.

products.name: ElevenLabs MCP in Claude
products.tagline: Create and manage ElevenLabs voice agents in your chat
products.summaryZh: 在聊天中创建并管理ElevenLabs语音代理。
products.descriptionZh: 将Claude连接到你的ElevenLabs工作区，以创建和管理语音代理。查找现有代理，查看其配置，更新提示词和语音，复制或删除代理。
products.description: Connect Claude to your ElevenLabs workspace to create and manage voice agents. Find existing agents, review their configuration, update prompts and voices, duplicate or delete agents.

products.name: Shepherd Terminal
products.tagline: A persistent terminal for Codex and Claude side by side
products.summaryZh: Codex与Claude并排使用的持久终端
products.descriptionZh: 在标签页、窗格和远程机器上运行编码代理。Shepherd在应用关闭时保持终端会话存活，追踪哪些代理正在工作或等待，并让你无需丢失上下文即可返回其文件和更改。代理理解当前Shepherd上下文，控制标签页和窗格，并通过浏览器审查收集反馈，同时你实时监控每个代理的状态。
products.description: Run coding agents across tabs, panes, and remote machines. Shepherd keeps terminal sessions alive when the app closes, tracks which agents are working or waiting, and lets you return to their files and changes without losing context. Agents understand the current Shepherd context, control tabs and panes, and collect feedback through browser reviews, while you monitor every agent’s status in real time.

products.name: Reckon
products.tagline: The decision journal that helps you calibrate
products.summaryZh: 助你校准决策的决策日志
products.descriptionZh: 大多数决定在做出那一刻便已尘埃落定。Reckon保留了事后被遗忘的部分：预测、信心、推理。检查点捕捉结果揭晓前的变动：新信息标注为正或负，信心随之更新。结果揭晓时，你记录发生了什么；数周后，它会询问你是否仍会做出同样的选择。一年下来，你看到信心何时过高，何时不足，判断力何时最为敏锐。适用于iPhone和iPad。iCloud同步，无需账户。一次性购买。
products.description: Most decisions feel resolved the moment you make them. Reckon keeps what hindsight erases: the prediction, the confidence, the reasoning. Check-ins capture what changes before the outcome: new info tagged positive or negative, confidence updated. At resolution you log what happened; weeks later it asks if you'd still make the call. A year in, you see where confidence overshoots, where it undershoots, where judgment is sharpest. iPhone and iPad. iCloud sync, no account. One-time purchase.

products.name: Atlas by WorkOS
products.tagline: Your AI coworker in Slack
products.summaryZh: 你在Slack中的AI同事
products.descriptionZh: Atlas在Slack中与你的团队协作，解答问题、自动化任务，并帮助每个人发挥最佳表现。
products.description: Atlas works alongside your team in Slack to answer questions, automate tasks, and help everyone do their best work.

products.name: Clipwing Autopilot
products.tagline: Get your clips without AI slop or hiring hassle
products.summaryZh: 无需AI杂讯，也无需雇佣麻烦，即可获取你的剪辑片段。
products.descriptionZh: Clipwing Autopilot并非又一款AI剪辑工具或编辑代理。您上传录音，选择编辑风格，即可获得风格统一、可直接发布的片段，无需雇佣编辑，也无需在Slack、Google Drive和排程工具之间来回切换。一切都在一个平台内完成，没有AI生成的劣质内容，也没有招聘的麻烦。
products.description: Clipwing Autopilot isn't another AI clipper or another editing agency You upload a recording, choose your editing style, and receive consistent, ready-to-post clips without hiring editors, or jumping between Slack, Google Drive, and scheduling tools. Everything happens in one place No AI slop, no hiring hassle

products.name: Finch
products.tagline: A single place for your health data and tests
products.summaryZh: 您的健康数据与检测，一站式集中管理。
products.descriptionZh: Finch是一款面向所有人的患者端健康伴侣，无论是准父母，还是正在应对医疗体系的人。仅怀孕一项就涉及至少12次预约、数十项检测结果，以及来自不同医疗机构、格式各异的新词汇。这只是一个例子。无论你的健康旅程如何，Finch都能将其整合到一个清晰的视图中，转录你在预约中的对话，并将临床术语转化为通俗易懂的语言。提供免费版本。Finch+ 每年99美元。
products.description: Finch is a patient-side health companion built for all — an expecting parent, or just someone navigating the health system. Pregnancy alone involves at least 12 appointments, dozens of test results, and a new vocabulary, coming from different providers in different formats. That's just one example. Whatever your journey, Finch brings it into one clear view, transcribes what was said at your appointments, and translates clinical language into plain English. Free tier available. Finch+ $99/y

products.name: Dates by Agenda Hero
products.tagline: Create a plan for anything. Share it with anyone.
products.summaryZh: 为任何事制定计划，并与任何人分享。
products.descriptionZh: 向Dates问好。这是规划你们共享约会时光的快乐方式。与500个家庭共享的学校日历。与家中每个人共享的家庭日历。与70位同事共享的销售启动议程。目前，这些日期还困在文档、表格、PDF和邮件中。因为此前没有更好的方式。直到今天。
products.description: Say hello to Dates. The joyful way to plan the dates you share. The school calendar you share with 500 other families. The family calendar you share with everyone at home. The sales kickoff agenda you share with 70 colleagues. Right now, those dates are stuck in docs, sheets, PDFs, and email. Because there hasn't been a better way. Until today.

products.name: Tiny Funnel
products.tagline: Funnel analytics you'll actually understand
products.summaryZh: 真正易懂的漏斗分析
products.descriptionZh: 真正易懂的漏斗分析。访客从哪里来，各自走到哪一步，多少人最终购买。将筛选条件调整至特定访客群体，例如“来自Google”加“至少到达第二步”，所有数据随之变化。目标是尽快给出答案和思路，因此筛选选项在选定前即显示其统计信息。无需Cookie，每位访客都被计入。向下滚动查看随时间变化的漏斗，以及任意访客的完整旅程。
products.description: Funnel analytics you'll actually understand. Where visitors come from, how far each gets, and how many buy. Change the filters to a specific visitor set, e.g. "from Google" + "reached at least step two", and everything changes with you. The goal is answers and ideas as fast as possible, so filter options show their stats before you pick one. Cookie-less, so everyone gets counted. Scroll down for your funnel through time, and any visitor's full journey.

products.name: Gauge
products.tagline: Agent Led Growth: Get written into every customer's codebase
products.summaryZh: 代理驱动增长：融入每位客户的代码库
products.descriptionZh: 不要使用Gauge。除非你希望你的工具被写进每一个代码库。智能体正引领我们客户的下一个增长浪潮，包括Supabase、Openrouter、Resend、PostHog、Mintlify、Braintrust等。与AI聊天不同，编码智能体正在自主实现产品。他们无需与销售代表交谈或参加演示就能做到这一点。Gauge运行真实的编码会话，以识别改进智能体偏好的行动，以及一旦你被选中后的智能体体验。
products.description: Don’t use Gauge. Unless you want your tool to get written into every codebase. Agents are leading the next wave of growth for our customers including Supabase, Openrouter, Resend, PostHog, Mintlify, Braintrust, and more. Unlike AI chat, coding agents are implementing products autonomously. They're doing so without ever talking to a sales rep or taking a demo. Gauge runs real coding sessions to identify actions to improve the agent’s preference, and the agent experience once you’re selected.

products.name: Deepmark
products.tagline: Search your bookmarks by what's inside them, not the title
products.summaryZh: 按书签内容搜索，而非标题。
products.descriptionZh: 浏览器书签、X书签、Instagram收藏和YouTube稍后观看，集中在一个私人资料库中，可用自然语言搜索。Deepmark读取每个页面，转录视频和短视频，描述并OCR帧内容，然后全部嵌入。“那个一锅意面技巧的短视频”能找到该视频，即使其中没有任何内容提到意面。收藏内容约90秒内可搜索；搜索超过1万条项目，响应时间低于100毫秒。此外，还提供托管MCP服务器：你的AI代理也能搜索你的资料库。
products.description: Your browser bookmarks, X bookmarks, Instagram saves and YouTube Watch Later, in one private library you can search in plain language. Deepmark reads every page, transcribes videos and reels, describes and OCRs frames, then embeds it all. 'The reel with the one-pan pasta trick' finds the reel even though nothing in it says pasta. A save is searchable in about 90 seconds; search over 10k items returns in under 100ms. Also a hosted MCP server: your AI agent can search your library too.

products.name: CrewTower
products.tagline: Control your agents from the notch
products.summaryZh: 从刘海区域控制你的智能体
products.descriptionZh: Crew Tower驻留在MacBook的刘海区域，监控你运行的每一个AI编程代理：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini、Qwen、OpenCode等。当代理需要权限时，请求会连同完整上下文显示在刘海区域：具体命令、文件编辑、问题。一键批准或拒绝，无需触碰终端。同时查看所有会话状态，运行中、等待中或已完成。当某个会话需要你时，直接跳转到对应的终端窗口。没有任何操作会无声停滞。
products.description: Crew Tower lives in your MacBook notch and watches every AI coding agent you run: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Qwen, OpenCode and more. When an agent needs permission, the request shows up in the notch with full context: the exact command, the file edit, the question. Approve or deny in one click, without touching the terminal. See every session at once, working, waiting or done. Jump straight to the right terminal window when one needs you. Nothing stalls silently.

products.name: Open Index
products.tagline: Build Smarter Agents using Structured Context
products.summaryZh: 使用结构化上下文构建更智能的代理
products.descriptionZh: 基于Markdown的上下文管理面临诸多挑战，如上下文污染、矛盾冲突、非确定性和导航困难。随着时间推移，我们在公司（DrDroid）构建了一套结构化的上下文管理层——通过Open Index，我们将其与整个生态系统共享！
products.description: Managing markdown based context comes with challenges like context poisoning, contradictions, non-determinism and context navigation difficulties. Over time, we built out a structured context management layer at our company (DrDroid) - with Open Index, we are sharing it with the ecosystem!

products.name: monolog
products.tagline: Chat to yourself and find anything by what you remember
products.summaryZh: 与自己对话，凭记忆找到任何东西。
products.descriptionZh: 与自己对话，其余交给monolog。无需管理标题、文件夹或标签。AI默默理解你的书写，识别日程与任务，在关键时刻提醒你。语义搜索按内容查找记录——即使你忘了具体用词。所有内容在iOS、Android、Web、桌面端和Chrome间保持同步。只需自然书写，monolog负责整理、记忆与日后查找。
products.description: Chat to yourself. monolog takes care of the rest. No titles, folders, or tags to manage. AI quietly understands what you write, recognizes schedules and tasks, and reminds you when it matters. Semantic search finds records by what they were about—even if you forgot the exact words you used. Everything stays synced across iOS, Android, Web, Desktop, and Chrome. Just write naturally. monolog handles the organizing, remembering, and finding later.

products.name: LayerProof Matte 3.0
products.tagline: Grow your social media content: posts, carousels and stories
products.summaryZh: 扩大社交媒体内容：帖子、轮播图和快拍
products.descriptionZh: 粘贴你的品牌或产品。LayerProof 构建你的品牌套件，然后一次性生成50条符合品牌调性的帖子，附带可直接发布的文案，全程在 LayerProof 内完成。用与 SaaS、快消、餐饮、咨询等行业营销人员和企业家共同设计的高转化内容，填满你的信息流。
products.description: Paste your brand or product. LayerProof builds your brand kit, then creates 50 on-brand posts in one sitting with captions ready to publish, right from LayerProof. Fill your feed with high-converting content, co-designed with marketers and business owners across SaaS, FMCG, Food and Beverage, Consulting and more

products.name: Meterless.ai
products.tagline: Run AI locally and own the whole workflow
products.summaryZh: 本地运行AI，掌控整个工作流程。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI工具给出答案后便丢弃过程。Meterless让真实工作流在你的设备上运行——并使其归你所有。Relay将桌面工作转化为可复用的任务。Gaia保持项目、记忆和上下文的持续性。Swarms展示完整的代理图谱。重放、编辑、切换模型，无需从头开始即可再次运行工作。本地优先、模型无关，构建方式让AI工作不断累积而非消失。
products.description: Most AI tools return an answer and discard the process. Meterless lets the real workflow run on your device—and makes it yours. Relay turns desktop work into reusable missions. Gaia keeps projects, memory, and context persistent. Swarms exposes the full agent graph. Replay, edit, switch models, and run the work again without starting over. Local-first, model-agnostic, and built so AI work compounds instead of disappearing.

products.name: AirBuddy 3
products.tagline: Easily manage devices and switch them between Macs
products.summaryZh: 轻松管理设备，并在多台Mac间切换。
products.descriptionZh: AirBuddy 3 带来了超过150项新功能和改进，包括全新设计、更强大的设备监控方式、更深入的媒体集成、焕然一新的 Magic Handoff，以及众多自动化和个性化新选项。
products.description: AirBuddy 3 brings over 150 new features and improvements, including a new design, powerful new ways to keep an eye on your devices, deeper media integration, revamped Magic Handoff, and many new options for automation and customization.
